# V1.9.1-2

Section: Source

**V1.9.1-2** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on October 13th, 2023.

## V1.9.1-2

- Fix - Resolved ship buoyancy and other gravity issues

V.1.9.2

- Fix - Jet engines now work efficiently up to much higher altitudes
- Fix - SRB fuel weight reduced
